name: Currency usage code qualifier
description: Code qualifying the usage of a currency.

values.name: Charge payment currency
values.description: Charge payment currency The currency in which charges are to be paid.

values.name: Reference currency
values.description: Reference currency The currency applicable to amounts stated. It may have to be converted.

values.name: Target currency
values.description: Target currency The currency which should be used to the target destination of the transaction.

values.name: Transport document currency
values.description: Transport document currency Currency applicable to amounts stated in a transport document/message.

values.name: Calculation base currency
values.description: Calculation base currency Currency on which the calculation is based.

values.name: Information Currency
values.description: Information Currency Additional currency the message recipient needs for information purposes. The actual message amount(s) is/are not based upon this currency.

values.name: Currency of the account
values.description: Currency of the account Currency in which the account is held.
